review.dall-e-3.no.dall-e.3.requires.cha: No. DALL-E 3 requires ChatGPT Plus ($20/month). There's no free tier. Alternatively, developers can access it via the OpenAI API (pay-per-image pricing).
review.dall-e-3.chatgpt.plus.has.a.soft: ChatGPT Plus has a soft cap of approximately 50 images every 3 hours. If you hit the limit, wait a few hours to continue. There's no hard monthly limit.
review.dall-e-3.yes.you.own.the.images: Yes! You own the images you create and can use them commercially—sell products, use in ads, publish in books, etc. No attribution required.
review.dall-e-3.dall-e.3.is.easier.to: DALL-E 3 is easier to use (ChatGPT interface vs Discord) and excellent for photorealism. Midjourney produces more artistic, cinematic images with better aesthetic quality. Choose DALL-E 3 for convenience and realism, Midjourney for artistic work.
review.dall-e-3.yes.but.with.limitations: Yes, but with limitations. Short text (1-5 words) usually works well. Longer text or complex typography often has spelling errors. For perfect text rendering, use Ideogram instead.
review.dall-e-3.yes.strong.ones.dall-e.3: Yes, strong ones. DALL-E 3 blocks NSFW, violence, copyrighted characters, public figures, and other sensitive content. This makes it safe for businesses but limits creative freedom compared to Stable Diffusion.
review.dall-e-3.not.within.chatgpt.no.in: Not within ChatGPT (no inpainting/outpainting). You can ask ChatGPT to regenerate with changes ("make the sky darker"), but you can't edit specific areas. For precise editing, export to Photoshop or use Stable Diffusion.
review.dall-e-3.get.chatgpt.plus.for.20m: Get ChatGPT Plus for $20/month and unlock DALL-E 3, GPT-4, and advanced features.
review.dall-e-3.access.chatgpt.plus.20mo: Access: ChatGPT Plus ($20/month), Enterprise, or via OpenAI API
review.dall-e-3.commercial.use.allowed.y: Commercial use allowed (you own the images)
review.dall-e-3.safety.filters.strong.co: Safety filters: Strong content moderation (no NSFW, violence, copyrighted characters)
Better prompt adherence: Follows complex instructions more accurately
review.dall-e-3.improved.hands.faces.few: Improved hands & faces: Fewer anatomy errors compared to DALL-E 2
review.dall-e-3.text.rendering.better.sp: Text rendering: Better spelling in images (though Ideogram still leads)
review.dall-e-3.editing.capabilities.cha: Editing capabilities: ChatGPT can iterate on images based on feedback
Faster generation: ~20-30 seconds per image (down from 60+)
review.dall-e-3.api.access.developers.ca: API access: Developers can integrate DALL-E 3 into apps
review.dall-e-3.natural.language.make.it: Natural language: "Make it more vibrant" or "Add a sunset" instead of learning syntax
review.dall-e-3.automatic.prompt.enhance: Automatic prompt enhancement: ChatGPT expands your simple request into a detailed prompt
review.dall-e-3.iterative.refinement.mak: Iterative refinement: "Make the sky darker" → ChatGPT generates a new version
